title: Playbook Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 📖️playbook plugin (✏️s/🔌️plugins/📖️playbook) from V1 taxonomy shape to the new Shape V2 tree-purity rule per TEMPLATE.md §14 in ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE. Mechanical only: relocate owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (update [lib] path, add ../../ prefix to #[path] strings), fold 🦀️config.rs and 🦀️terminology.rs siblings into their own component folders, relocate 📚️examples and AGENTS.md to owner root (already there), verify check/clippy/test, confirm tree purity. 🧩️extensions/🌀️procedural is explicitly untouched.
summary: Retrofitted 📖️playbook to Shape V2 tree purity. Moved 📦️lib.rs → 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (Cargo.toml [lib] path "../../📦️lib.rs" → "📦️lib.rs"). Folded 🎛️apps/📖️playbook/🦀️config.rs → 🎛️apps/📖️playbook/🎚️config/🦀️component.rs and 🦀️terminology.rs → 🗣️terminology/🦀️component.rs. AGENTS.md and 📚️examples were already at owner root (no move needed). Fixed one stale doc-comment reference in ⚙️engine/🦀️component.rs pointing to the old config.rs path. Found and fixed a real #[path]-composition bug in my own mechanical transform: naively prefixing EVERY #[path] string with ../../ (including nested "." resets and leaf paths) causes multiplicative over-shifting since nested "." resets compose additively down the module tree — only the outermost (zero-indent, declared directly in lib.rs) mod declarations need the ../../ prefix; nested resets and leaf full-paths keep their original V1 values. Verified via isolated-workspace overlay (root cargo metadata blocked by other sessions' in-flight plugins, not mine): cargo check clean, clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean (own crate; one pre-existing unrelated warning in dependency semio-framework-plugin), cargo test --lib 50/50 passed (matches pre-retrofit baseline exactly). Tree confirmed pure: only AGENTS.md/📚️examples at owner root and 🦀️component.rs/plain folders/📦️packages below it. 🧩️extensions/🌀️procedural untouched. No registrar handoff needed (root Cargo.toml member line unchanged).
